# CTV News

> > CTV News is Canada's leading news network providing national and regional coverage of breaking news, politics, weather, and local stories across Canadian provinces and territories.

CTV News delivers comprehensive journalism across Canada with dedicated regional bureaus. The network covers federal and provincial politics, Indigenous affairs, economic developments, and community news with particular strength in Alberta coverage including Edmonton and Calgary markets.

## Key Topics

- Alberta politics
- Federal NDP
- Edmonton local news
- Calgary regional coverage
- First Nations and Treaty 8
- Provincial government
- NDP leadership
- Budget 2026
- Political discourse
- Avi Lewis
- Michael Higgins
- Calgary Chamber of Commerce
- Alberta Primetime
- Canadian breaking news

## Alberta Regional Coverage

- [Edmonton: Local News, Weather & Traffic Updates](https://alberta.ctvnews.ca/): Edmonton & Alberta local news, politics, weather covering NDP & provincial govt
